english.title: Lodging in a barn / outhouse / unoccupied building / open air - Vagrancy Act 1824
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) wandered abroad and,

(A)_[having failed to apply for accommodation at a reasonably accessible place of shelter to which you had been directed,]_
(B)_[having been refused accommodation at a reasonably accessible place of shelter to which you had been directed,]_
(C)_[notwithstanding that a place of shelter was reasonably accessible, attempted to lodge or]_
(D)_[by or in the course of lodging, caused damage to property or in such circumstances as appeared to have been likely to do so]_
(E)_[by or in the course of lodging, caused infection with vermin or in such circumstances as appeared to have been likely to do so]_
(F)_[by or in the course of lodging, caused offensive consequences or in such circumstances as appeared to have been likely to do so]_

lodged

(G)_[in a barn]_
(H)_[in an outhouse]_
(I)_[in a deserted or unoccupied building]_
(J)_[in the open air]_
(K)_[under a tent]_
(L)_[in a cart or waggon]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), not having given a good account of yourself
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4 of the Vagrancy Act 1824, section 70 of the Criminal Justice Act 1982 and section 26(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 1991.

english.notes:
(i) This offence should not be used after 28th June 2026 due to repeal by the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022.
(ii) Made a recordable offence as from 1/12/03 by the National Police Records (Recordable Offences)(Amendment) Regulations 2003.
